_comment: PHASE FIVE-K.1 -- new eligible-workout set for the FIVE_K Intermediate 4D/5D V1 matrix (FIVE-K.0B §16/§48-49): EASY_STANDARD, LONG_RUN_STANDARD, THRESHOLD_TEMPO (all pre-existing, reused unchanged) plus the two new FIVE_K catalog additions (VO2_INTERVAL_FIVE_K, GOAL_PACE_FIVE_K). Deliberately omits FARTLEK/HM_PACE -- FIVE-K.0B's frozen workout progression never uses either. References the new dedicated progressionModifier v5 (maximumHardSessionsPerWeek=1, allowSecondHardStimulus=false) -- numerically identical to TEN_K's own v2 and HALF_MARATHON's own v4, but FIVE_K's own separate artifact, per this repository's established cross-distance-family ownership discipline (see intermediate-progression-modifier.v5.json's own doc comment). This mechanism is what guarantees a future shared adapter can never silently inject a second quality day at FIVE_K Intermediate x5D (FIVE-K.0B §19's no-KEY2 invariant).
